topic: ERC-4626 offline arithmetic and underlying dependency corrections, 2026-09-21

facts.value: Conversion evaluates checked uint256 totalAssets+1, totalSupply+10**offset, then Math.mulDiv with a 512-bit product and bounded quotient. Ceil also checks the final increment. A product exceeding uint256 alone is not an overflow.
facts.note: conformance/fixtures/oz-v5-oracle.md records compiler/source/runtime hashes and the Rust-built offline source-execution oracle. The oracle executes inherited conversion methods without copying their formulas into a Solidity wrapper. This is not deployed-runtime qualification.

facts.value: FiatTokenV2_2._balanceOf masks balanceAndBlacklistStates with (2**255)-1; bit 255 is blacklist state. The compiled inherited FiatTokenV1 layout places this mapping at slot 9.
facts.note: Existing compiler evidence docs/evidence/storage-layouts/fiat-token@v2.2.0.json is preserved. The OZ fixture explicitly selects fiat-token-v2_2-low255; another layout cannot inherit this decoder implicitly.

facts.value: UpgradeabilityProxy stores the implementation at keccak256(org.zeppelinos.proxy.implementation), 0x7050c9e0f4ca769c69bd3a8ef740bc37934f8e2c036e5a723fd8ee048ed3f8c3. The bound asset implementation is a depth-2 storage-pointer dependency. Every persisted pointer write and code changes to the asset or bound implementation invalidate the vault epoch.
facts.note: Synthetic fixture implementation 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000022 is an explicit placeholder. Same-value SSTORE and change-and-restore writes are covered separately; reverted writes do not contribute. No claim is made about USDC's current runtime.

open_questions: Deployed runtime hashes, actual implementation addresses and activation blocks require separate owner-authorized live qualification.
